programme.desc: Derek Brockway travels to the seaside town of New Quay on Cardigan Bay where Dylan Thomas and his wife Caitlin lived during the war. He is joined by guide Jeff Towns to learn why the couple's time there was so dramatic and how it inspired some of Thomas's greatest work.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries

programme.title: Vasa: The Ghost Ship

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.sub-title: The Age of the Steam Locomotive
programme.desc: Fred Dibnah explores the revolutionary impact of steam engines on rail transport. In the process, Fred examines both the earliest colliery railways and the end of steam power on commercial railways in the 1960s.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds, and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson unlocks the ancient roots of the Northumberland village of Warkworth. With the help of locals, he discovers clues that point back almost 1,000 years to the Norman conquest and how the invaders laid the foundations of a planned community, still visible to this day.

programme.title: Inside Classical
programme.sub-title: Halloween Spooktacular with BBC National Orchestra of Wales
programme.desc: Join presenter and musician Owain Wyn Evans for a concert full of Halloween tricks and treats. The BBC National Orchestra of Wales, conducted by Ellie Slorach, perform music that is guaranteed to give you a thrill.The concert includes Bach's gothic masterpiece Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Saint-Saëns Danse Macabre and the spine-tingling Rimsky Korsakov's arrangement of Mussorgsky's Night on the Bare Mountain.
